feature: Deterministic 7-signal confidence equation replacing heuristic follow_up_needed flag
problem: Agent emits conf=0.70 for all commits regardless of evidence quality. On n=50 eval: 8 BUG commits get MEDIUM (D1 miss) because diffs look cosmetic, 6 clean commits get HIGH (FP) because LLM finds plausible risk without signal/noise separation. Both are calibration failures.
proposed_solution: Two new modules in src/commit_investigator/analysis/: signal_extractor.py (deterministic InvestigationContext+TagResults→ConfidenceSignals) and confidence_model.py (ConfidenceSignals→scalar+tier). Wire confidence_tier into orchestrator._should_follow_up() (replaces gate heuristic) and risk_policy LOW_CONFIDENCE cap. Add calibrate_confidence.py script. Unit tests cover all signals and the model.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: signal_extractor.py exports extract_confidence_signals(context: InvestigationContext, tagged: list[TagResult], hypotheses: list[HypothesisSpec]) -> ConfidenceSignals with all 7 signal fields: supported_count, evidence_density, router_agreement, hypothesis_diversity, diff_signal_ratio, missing_context_flags, commit_message_clarity. router_agreement: 1.0 when router_probability>=0.7 AND base_risk==HIGH, 0.0 when router_probability>=0.7 AND base_risk!=HIGH, 0.5 when router_probability is None or <0.7 (base_risk derived same as evaluate_risk_from_hypotheses: HIGH if supported_count>=1 or defect_signals or router_prior>=0.7).

AC-2: confidence_model.py exports compute_confidence(signals: ConfidenceSignals) -> ConfidenceResult with fields: score (float 0..1), tier (Literal['HIGH','MEDIUM','LOW']). Score uses fixed weights from state.json candidate_equation: 0.35*supported_score + 0.25*router_agreement + 0.20*evidence_density + 0.10*diversity_score + 0.10*message_clarity - 0.05*missing_context_penalty (each component normalized to [0,1]; missing_context_penalty capped so score stays in [0,1]). Tier thresholds: score>=0.65 → HIGH, 0.40<=score<0.65 → MEDIUM, score<0.40 → LOW.
AC-3: All 7 signal extractors are purely deterministic — zero LLM calls, no network I/O, no file I/O

AC-4: orchestrator._should_follow_up() returns True when ConfidenceResult.tier == 'MEDIUM' OR evaluate_gate(artifact).follow_up_needed is True (T1-T4 safety triggers preserved); returns False when turn >= max_turns; FollowUpMode.ALWAYS unchanged. quality_gate.evaluate_gate() remains callable and its 392-test suite behavior unchanged.

AC-5: evaluate_risk_from_hypotheses() accepts ConfidenceResult (or computes it internally from tagged+context+hypotheses) and applies LOW_CONFIDENCE cap: if tier=='LOW', risk_level capped at MEDIUM regardless of supported_count, unless has_production_defect_signals(context) is True (defect signals bypass cap). PolicyVerdict gains confidence_score: float field populated from ConfidenceResult.score.

AC-6: calibrate_confidence.py reads existing run output JSONs under --run-dir (investigations/ + evaluations/; no new LLM calls) and prints one line per signal with signal name and Gini coefficient in [0,1] as D1 AUC proxy; stdout must list all 7 signal names with parseable numeric Gini values
AC-7: Unit tests for signal_extractor.py cover all 7 signals with at least one positive and one negative case each
AC-8: Unit tests for confidence_model.py cover tier boundaries: inputs yielding score>=0.65 → HIGH, 0.40<=score<0.65 → MEDIUM, score<0.40 → LOW, including exact boundary scores 0.65 and 0.40

AC-9: tests/test_orchestrator.py (or tests/test_confidence_integration.py) asserts _should_follow_up returns True for MEDIUM tier and preserves T1 gate fire (supported_count==0 + production_defect_signals)
AC-10: All existing 392 tests continue to pass (no regressions)
edge_cases: EC-1: context.diff is None or empty — diff_signal_ratio returns 0.0, supported_count and evidence_density derived from TagResults only
EC-2: hypotheses list is empty — evidence_density=0.0, hypothesis_diversity=0, supported_count=0
EC-3: context.router_probability is None — router_agreement defaults to 0.5 (neutral)
EC-4: context.message is None or empty — commit_message_clarity returns 0.0
EC-5: All 7 signals at max/min simultaneously — score clamps to [0.0, 1.0]
EC-6: missing_context_flags > 3 — penalty is capped so score cannot go below 0.0
EC-7: score exactly 0.65 → tier HIGH; score exactly 0.40 → tier MEDIUM (inclusive lower bound)
EC-8: tier==LOW with has_production_defect_signals(context)==True — risk cap skipped, risk_level may remain HIGH
verification_method: Run pytest tests/test_signal_extractor.py tests/test_confidence_model.py tests/test_orchestrator.py -v -k 'confidence or follow_up or gate' (all pass). Run full pytest (392+ tests, zero failures). Grep orchestrator.py: compute_confidence or extract_confidence_signals called inside _should_follow_up; grep confirms evaluate_gate still invoked (OR logic). Grep risk_policy.py for confidence_score and LOW tier cap with defect-signal bypass. Run: python calibrate_confidence.py --run-dir output/runs/2026-06-11_14-34-34_real_n11 — stdout lists all 7 signals with numeric Gini in [0,1], exit 0.
